assertions.description: Working directory is agentic-starter-kits repo root
Agent directory exists under agents/
Agent has a recognized entrypoint (main.py, entrypoint.sh, or deploymentModel in agent.yaml)
Agent has agent.yaml with name field
Agent has Makefile
Integration tests do not already exist for this agent
Shared integration test infrastructure exists at tests/integration/
Agent path argument provided and non-empty
assertions.pass_if: First word of skill args contains a / separator (e.g. a2a/langgraph_crewai_agent)

assertions.description: __init__.py exists in tests/integration/
conftest.py exists with shared fixture re-exports
test_deployment.py exists with health check test
conftest.py re-exports shared fixtures via 'from integration.conftest import cluster_auth, repo_root'
test_deployment.py has @pytest.mark.integration marker
test_deployment.py has test_health_endpoint function
test_deployment.py uses deployed_agent fixture
Deployment method in fixture matches discovered deploy_method trait
assertions.pass_if: If deploy_method is openshift_build: deployed_agent fixture calls run_make('build-openshift') and INTERNAL_REGISTRY constant is present. If deploy_method is external_registry: deployed_agent fixture calls run_make('build') + run_make('push'), CONTAINER_IMAGE is in _REQUIRED_ENV, and no INTERNAL_REGISTRY constant exists. If deploy_method is pre_deployed: deployed_agent fixture only discovers existing route with get_route(), no run_make calls, no _write_env_file, no teardown.

assertions.description: Makefile has test-integration target
test-integration target sets PYTHONPATH to repo root tests/
Unit test target ignores tests/integration/
CI workflow matrix includes the agent path
CI workflow YAML has valid syntax after edit
assertions.pass_if: The agent-deployment-test.yaml file has valid YAML syntax. The matrix entry follows the pattern: { name: <slug>, dir: agents/<path> }

assertions.description: pytest --collect-only passes with no import errors
assertions.pass_if: Running PYTHONPATH=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests uv run --extra dev python -m pytest tests/integration/test_deployment.py --collect-only -q from the agent dir shows at least 1 test collected (1 for standard agents, 2 for has_multiple_deployments agents), no errors

phase-5b-live.description: Phase 5b: Live cluster integration test (if cluster available)

assertions.description: Logged into OpenShift cluster (required for live test)
make test-integration passed against live cluster
assertions.pass_if: make test-integration completed with exit 0, test_health_endpoint PASSED, agent was deployed (or pre-deployed agent was verified), health-checked, and torn down (if applicable). OR: cluster not available / registry auth unavailable, test skipped with reason documented.

waiver.condition: No cluster access available (oc whoami fails or not in ci-testing namespace), or external registry auth unavailable for external_registry agents
waiver.action: Skip live test, document that it was not run. Test collection (5a) is sufficient for PR.

phase-5c-consistency.description: Phase 5c: Cross-agent consistency check (adapts to discovered capabilities)

assertions.description: conftest.py follows the correct pattern for the agent's discovered capabilities
assertions.pass_if: conftest.py uses 'from integration.conftest import cluster_auth, repo_root'. For openshift_build with no extra env vars: 2-line re-export. For openshift_build with extra env vars: full file with INTERNAL_REGISTRY, _REQUIRED_ENV, fixtures, _write_env_file, deployed_agent using build-openshift. For external_registry: full file with _REQUIRED_ENV (including CONTAINER_IMAGE), fixtures, _write_env_file, deployed_agent using build+push+deploy. For pre_deployed: minimal file with fixtures and deployed_agent that only discovers existing route.

assertions.description: test_deployment.py follows the correct structure for the agent's discovered capabilities
assertions.pass_if: For openshift_build with no extra env vars: test_deployment.py contains INTERNAL_REGISTRY, agent_dir, agent_name, _write_env_file, deployed_agent, and test_health_endpoint. For all other deploy_method/env combinations: test_deployment.py is minimal — only imports, test_health_endpoint, and (if has_multiple_deployments) test_all_deployments_healthy.

assertions.description: _write_env_file validates the correct required env vars for this agent
assertions.pass_if: For openshift_build with no extra vars: checks ('BASE_URL', 'MODEL_ID'). For openshift_build with extra vars: _REQUIRED_ENV includes all discovered extra vars. For external_registry: _REQUIRED_ENV includes CONTAINER_IMAGE plus any extra vars. For pre_deployed: no _write_env_file function exists.

assertions.description: Health endpoint and assertions match the discovered traits
assertions.pass_if: Health endpoint path in test matches discovered health_endpoint. Assertions match health_response_schema: 'standard' checks status+agent_initialized, 'status_only' checks status only, 'agent_card' validates JSON structure with name field, 'http_200' checks status code only.

assertions.description: Multi-deployment agents verify all components
assertions.pass_if: If has_multiple_deployments is true: test_all_deployments_healthy exists and checks each deployment name in _DEPLOYMENT_NAMES. If has_multiple_deployments is false: single deployed_agent route is sufficient, no test_all_deployments_healthy needed.

post.description: All phases complete — integration tests added

assertions.description: All three integration test files exist
Makefile has test-integration target
CI workflow includes the agent
Phase 5a: Test collection passed
assertions.pass_if: pytest --collect-only succeeded with at least 1 test collected (2 for has_multiple_deployments agents) and no errors

assertions.description: Phase 5b: Live test result documented
assertions.pass_if: Live integration test either passed (PASS) or was skipped due to no cluster access / missing registry auth (WAIVED with reason)

assertions.description: Phase 5c: Cross-agent consistency verified
assertions.pass_if: New test files follow the correct pattern for the agent's discovered capabilities: openshift_build agents with no extra env vars use 2-line conftest re-export + full test_deployment.py; openshift_build with extra env vars use full conftest.py + minimal test_deployment.py; external_registry agents use full conftest.py with build+push+deploy and CONTAINER_IMAGE + minimal test_deployment.py; pre_deployed agents use minimal conftest.py with route-only discovery + minimal test_deployment.py. Health assertions match discovered health_response_schema. Multi-deployment agents verify all components. Env vars in _write_env_file match agent.yaml and env template.
